requirement:
Evidence inputs MAY have a definition form containing exactly `definition` and `text`. `definition` MUST identify one named definition; `text` MUST contain its complete raw fenced declaration as source lines, including its phrase option and explanatory body.

Validation MUST reject missing definitions and changed snapshot text, identifying the definition and showing a compact diff when available. Moving an unchanged definition within its chapter MUST NOT invalidate its snapshot. Evidence displays MUST show the definition name, current source location, and recorded text.
rationale:
I found no gaps. Each obligation maps to marked code and a test that asserts its outcome.

**Obligations and code**
- **Form with exactly `definition` and `text` (MAY).** `validate_input` (src/evidence.rs:792) calls `check_keys` for `["definition","text"]`, which rejects unexpected fields. `text_field` requires a nonempty array of strings. `InputSelector::from_input` and `to_input` (src/inputs.rs) parse and record this form.
- **`definition` MUST identify one named definition.** `InputSelector::resolve` (src/inputs.rs:244) looks up the name in `definitions`, filtered to `DefinitionKind::Term`. Otherwise it returns "no matching named definition".
- **`text` MUST contain the complete raw fenced declaration, including the phrase option and body.** `resolve` returns `redact_lines(&target.raw_lines)`. `collect_definitions` builds `raw_lines` from the whole fenced block, so the fence lines, `:phrase:` line and body are included. The test's `:phrase: beta` edit produces "input text changed", which confirms the phrase line is part of the snapshot.
- **Reject missing definitions.** `validate_resolved_input` (src/evidence.rs:952) pushes the resolve error. That error is prefixed with the definition name.
- **Reject changed text, identifying the definition and showing a compact diff.** `validate_resolved_input` compares the recorded and current text and emits "input text changed for {selector:?}" plus `compact_diff`. The `{selector:?}` output includes the definition name.
- **Moving an unchanged definition MUST NOT invalidate the snapshot.** The comparison uses only raw text and ignores line numbers. Line ranges are not recorded in the input.
- **Evidence displays MUST show name, current location and recorded text.** `render_input` (src/index.rs:825) labels the input "definition {name}" and renders the current ranges through `render_source_location`. Those ranges come from `InputLocation::resolve`, which carries the name, file and line_start/line_end. It then emits the recorded `text` as a markdown code block.

**Tests**
- `tests/definitions.rs::changed_definition_snapshots_show_a_compact_diff_and_text_is_required` asserts that a changed body line produces an error naming `glossary.a` and a diff of exactly one `-` line and one `+` line. It also asserts that missing, empty or non-array `text` is rejected.
- `tests/definitions.rs::cyclic_dependencies_are_required_once_and_changes_require_review` covers moving a definition (prepended blank lines leave validation clean). It also covers changes to the phrase option and to the body, each of which is rejected.
- `tests/definitions.rs::definition_schema_deletion_and_literal_references_are_checked` covers an unexpected field and a deleted definition ("no matching named definition").
- `src/index.rs::detail_page_shows_recorded_text_locations_and_first_matching_group` asserts that the display shows the definition name, `md/rules.md:9–13` and the recorded text. It also asserts that an unresolved selector is reported and its recorded text kept.

**Marking**
The relevant code carries `{impl}` references to this requirement. I found no unmarked implementing code. `compact_diff` and `check_keys` are marked for `ci.diagnostics` and `ci.schema`, and `validate_resolved_input` carries the `{impl}` reference for this requirement. I found no unspecified behavior in the implementation.
